messages.content: Hey—need a refill on my diabetes meds. My pharmacy's out but I'm 40 miles from town. Can you help?
Hi pt-1002. I can't process refills or arrange transport. But a nurse can contact your doctor about options like mail delivery. Want me to set that up?
Median response time is 31 hours. She might be able to work something out faster if it's urgent.
Not urgent but I'd like it handled soon. Also got a glucose reading if you need it—127 this morning fasting.
Logged that reading. I'm escalating to a nurse now who can reach out to your doctor about the refill. Check in with you next week?

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
